news.title: Owned Item Tracking
news.text:
You can now track which items you own or want in the Atomic Shop!
Mark items easily, to see which items, bundles, or partial bundles you already have or want to get.

Manage your tracked items in the Database Browser via the 'Item Tracking' button (top right), or mark items directly using the '✔' and '❤' icons.

 ̶T̶r̶a̶c̶k̶e̶d̶ ̶i̶t̶e̶m̶s̶ ̶s̶h̶o̶u̶l̶d̶ ̶s̶y̶n̶c̶ ̶a̶u̶t̶o̶m̶a̶t̶i̶c̶a̶l̶l̶y̶,̶ ̶b̶u̶t̶ ̶i̶f̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶y̶ ̶d̶o̶n̶’̶t̶ ̶u̶p̶d̶a̶t̶e̶ ̶r̶i̶g̶h̶t̶ ̶a̶w̶a̶y̶,̶ you can use the import button at the bottom of the website. (there was a limit on how much data could be synced via cookies)
(Do not forget to export your tracked items before clearing your browser cache or just in case!)
